agentHostingConfigurations.description: Customer-owned AKS hosting configurations for Foundry agents. This property can only be specified when the account is created; an existing account without a hosting configuration cannot add one later. This API version supports exactly one configuration, while the array shape is reserved for future API versions that may support multiple configurations. Once set, the configuration cannot be changed, removed, or reordered. Account update requests should omit this property or send the complete existing value unchanged. Responses only include hosting configuration types defined by the requested API version.

trustedCertificateSources.description: Private CA trust sources for supported features in an AIServices account with allowProjectManagement enabled. Supports one Azure Key Vault source containing version-pinned references to secrets with PEM-encoded CA certificates or certificate bundles. On PUT or PATCH, a non-null array replaces the complete configuration, so include all references to retain. Omit this property or send null to preserve the existing configuration; send an empty array to clear it.

costControlConnections.description:

mode.description:
The enforcement mode for egress rules.
If omitted on create, the server defaults to Enforced. On subsequent GET
requests, the server always returns the effective mode.

defaultAction.description:
The default action when no user-defined rules match.
Deny blocks unmatched traffic; Allow permits it. Transform and Rewrite rules
are always applied to their matched traffic regardless of this setting —
defaultAction only governs traffic that does not match any rule.
If omitted on create, the server defaults to Deny (fail-closed). On subsequent
GET requests, the server always returns the effective value.

rules.description:
Ordered list of egress rules. First matching rule wins.
Rules are evaluated in declaration order; the first rule whose match criteria
are satisfied determines the action taken on the request.

name.description: Name of the rule. Must be unique within the policy.

ruleType.description: The type of rule (e.g., Fqdn). Determines how match criteria are interpreted.

match.description: The match criteria for this rule.

action.description:
The action to take when this rule matches, including the action type and any
type-specific configuration (headers for Transform, rewrite target for Rewrite).

host.description:
Host pattern to match using DNS wildcard syntax (e.g., "\*.openai.com").
A leading "\*." matches any subdomain. Omit to match all hosts.

path.description:
Path pattern to match using URI prefix matching.
An asterisk serves as a single-segment wildcard.
For example, "/v1/\*" matches "/v1/chat". Omit to match all paths.

headers.description:
Header transforms to apply. Required for Transform; optional for Rewrite;
not allowed for Allow or Deny.

rewrite.description: Destination override. Required for Rewrite; not allowed otherwise.

operation.description: The operation to perform on this header.

systemData.description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

provider.description: The resource provider for this budget. Omission selects Microsoft.CognitiveServices; responses return that value.

grouping.description:
Optional additional partitioning of consumption. Omission or an empty array uses one counter for the owning account or Foundry project.
Responses omit owner-default grouping. A project-owned control cannot explicitly group by project.

category.description: Whether the budget measures estimated cost in United States dollars or token consumption. This category cannot be changed after creation.

amount.description:
The positive budget amount, measured in United States dollars for the Cost category or in tokens for the Tokens category.
Token amounts must be whole numbers.

timeGrain.description: The calendar-aligned UTC interval at which consumption counters renew within the validity window.

timePeriod.description: The finite UTC validity window during which the control applies.

filter.description: Optional traffic selection. Omission selects all eligible traffic within the owner's scope.

notifications.description:
Alert notifications keyed by nonempty, case-insensitively unique names. Each notification supplies its own Event Grid connection.
PUT and the complete merged PATCH result may contain at most one notification, including disabled notifications.
Omission on creation creates no notifications.

providerProperties.description: Optional provider-specific enforcement settings. Omission creates no blocking actions.

name.description: The built-in attribute to group by. project is available only for account-owned controls.

type.description: The grouping kind. Only `AdditionalInfoKey` is supported.

startDate.description: The inclusive UTC start, encoded as an ISO 8601 timestamp ending in Z with up to seven fractional digits.

endDate.description: The exclusive UTC end, later than startDate, encoded as an ISO 8601 timestamp ending in Z with up to seven fractional digits.

additionalInfo.description: A single additional-info condition. Must not be combined with `and` on the same filter object.

and.description: A conjunction of at least two conditions. Must not be combined with `additionalInfo` on the same filter object.

name.description:
The built-in attribute: agent, sessionId, project, deployment, or tokenType.
Resource selectors use owner-scoped short names, not Azure resource IDs. Agent selections require an explicit project filter selecting exactly one project; multiple agents in that project are supported.
A project-owned control can select only its owning project. Project, agent, and deployment values must be plain names of 1-64 characters without leading or trailing whitespace, control characters, path/query/fragment separators, percent signs, or . and .. path segments.
tokenType accepts input, output, or both for a Tokens budget; omission measures overall tokens.

values.description: One or more nonempty, non-whitespace strings to match. There is no per-condition value-count limit; the serialized cost-control definition must not exceed 32 KiB.

eventGridConnectionId.description: The full resource ID of the Cognitive Services Event Grid connection used to publish this notification.

thresholdType.description: Whether threshold is a percentage of amount or an absolute value in the budget's unit.

threshold.description: The positive threshold. Percentages cannot exceed 100; absolute thresholds cannot exceed amount and must be whole numbers for Tokens budgets.

enabled.description: Whether this notification is enabled. Disabled notifications remain configured but do not publish alerts.

operator.description: The threshold comparison. Only `GreaterThanOrEqualTo` is supported.

actions.description:
Blocking actions keyed by nonempty, case-insensitively unique names.
PUT and the complete merged PATCH result may contain at most one Block action, independently of the notification limit.
Omission on creation creates no blocking actions.

type.description: The enforcement action. Only `Block` is supported.

thresholdType.description: Whether threshold is a percentage of amount or an absolute value in the budget's unit.

threshold.description: The positive threshold. Percentages cannot exceed 100; absolute thresholds cannot exceed amount and must be whole numbers for Tokens budgets.

operator.description: The threshold comparison. Only `GreaterThanOrEqualTo` is supported.
